recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It applies the published Pharmacy clarification in the current active source without changing effective[x] cardinality or adding a redundant new element.
issue_request: FHIR-37372 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking how to record both a MedicationUsage usage period and last administration time when effective[x] has cardinality 0..1. The resolution said to record them as two separate MedicationUsage statements and update the Effective[x] comments.
initial_application: The historical commit 0e463239a18c2754e691aecf97c70119c5891b41 was tagged with FHIR-37372, FHIR-35899, and FHIR-36001, but its visible MedicationUsage source changes added partOf and schema metadata rather than the requested effective[x] guidance. Current source had been normalized back to MedicationStatement and still carried the older period-focused effective[x] comment.
additional_context: FHIR-35899, resolved and published one day earlier, established that effectiveDateTime is the correct way to record the last time a medication was taken/administered; Pharmacy WGM minutes record the related vote. FHIR-37372 was created while resolving FHIR-35899 and covers the coupled case where both a usage period and a last administration time are needed. source/fhir.ini confirms MedicationStatement is the active current build-scope resource.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml and the matching source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-event-mapping-exceptions.xml resource comment so the built StructureDefinition and mapping exception metadata carry the same guidance.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: clarified MedicationStatement.effective[x] comment for effectiveDateTime, effectivePeriod/effectiveTiming, and two statements for period plus last administration.
source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the Event mapping exception resource comment with the StructureDefinition comment.
